links.reason: PDGFRA is a common marker for all ASPCs; the ASPC markers source contains DEGs for all six ASPC subpopulations.
ALDH1A3 characterizes ADIPOSE STEM AND PROGENITOR CELL 2, which is listed in the ASPC markers source.
EPHA3 marks ADIPOSE STEM AND PROGENITOR CELL 4, listed in the ASPC markers source.
CD14 marks macrophages at the broad cell-type level; the all markers source contains MACROPHAGE as a category.
CD96 marks natural killer cells at the broad level; NATURAL KILLER CELL is in the all markers source.
CPA3 marks mast cells at the broad level; MAST CELL is in the all markers source.
CSF3R marks neutrophils at the broad level; NEUTROPHIL is in the all markers source.
CLEC9A marks dendritic cell subpopulation 1, corresponding to DENDRITIC CELL 1 in the immune markers source.
CD1C marks dendritic cell subpopulation 2, corresponding to DENDRITIC CELL 2 in the immune markers source.
CTLA4 marks regulatory T cells; REGULATORY T CELL is listed in the immune markers source.
PRLR marks endometrial cells; ENDOMETRIUM is listed in the all markers source.
CFD is highly expressed in hAd3, corresponding to ADIPOCYTE 3 in the adipocyte markers source.
INSR, IRS1, IRS2 are most highly expressed in hAd5, corresponding to ADIPOCYTE 5 in the adipocyte markers source.
DGAT2, SREBF1, PNPLA3 are higher in hAd3, corresponding to ADIPOCYTE 3 in the adipocyte markers source.
ELOVL5 and FADS3 are highest in hAd4, corresponding to ADIPOCYTE 4 in the adipocyte markers source.
EBF2, ESRRG, PPARGC1A are selectively expressed in hAd6, corresponding to ADIPOCYTE 6 in the adipocyte markers source.
ADIPOQ is a general adipocyte marker; ADIPOCYTE is listed in the all markers source at the broad cell-type level.
